Careful: Syndicate Highwaymen are level 30-31 and can cast Sneak while out of combat, so they are often stealthed and hard to spot.

Escort the professor to the beach north of the cove and guard him while he works; naga attack in waves. Careful: The ambush is two level 40 water elementals, and they are immune to frost. If the fight happens inside the cave, the professor joins in instead of working and further elementals keep appearing; holding the elementals at the cave entrance, away from him, lets him finish with only the first two to deal with.

Each key lies at one of the Highlands' standing-stone circles: east of the shards, near Refuge Pointe and in the west. The Pierre de Lien Intérieure stands west of Refuge Pointe. Careful: Each center stone is guarded by around three elementals near level 39 that attack together if you click the stone without clearing them: Burning Exiles at West, Thundering Exiles at Outer, Cresting Exiles at East.

l.x: These are elite mobs: grouping up is encouraged, look for people to do it with. Grel'borg l'Avare is a level 40 elite: most classes solo it at level 42, but you may need help. Skip it if you are alone: the route has you grind the XP back.
